parsed_entries.requirement: Public authorities must maintain a directory of their officers and employees.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify the existence of a publicly accessible directory listing all officers and employees.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all public authorities subject to the RTI Act 2005.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to disclose information about their personnel.

parsed_entries.requirement: Public authorities must disclose the monthly remuneration of their officers and employees.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify the publication of detailed salary information for all officers and employees.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all public authorities subject to the RTI Act 2005.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement mandates transparency in financial disclosures related to personnel.

parsed_entries.requirement: Public authorities must disclose the budget allocated to each agency, including planned expenditures and disbursements.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify the publication of detailed budget information for each agency, including planned and actual expenditures.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all public authorities subject to the RTI Act 2005.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures transparency in financial planning and execution.

parsed_entries.requirement: Public authorities must disclose the manner of execution of subsidy programmes, including beneficiaries and amounts allocated.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify the publication of detailed information on subsidy programmes, including beneficiaries and allocated amounts.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all public authorities subject to the RTI Act 2005.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures transparency in the implementation of subsidy programmes.

parsed_entries.requirement: Public authorities must disclose details of information held in electronic form.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify the publication of information on the availability and nature of electronic records held by the authority.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all public authorities subject to the RTI Act 2005.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures transparency in the management of electronic records.

parsed_entries.requirement: Public authorities must disclose the particulars of facilities available to citizens for obtaining information.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify the publication of details on facilities available to citizens for accessing information, including working hours of public libraries or reading rooms.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all public authorities subject to the RTI Act 2005.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures transparency in the availability of public information access facilities.
